siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Castor
siblings.summary: One B&B (Casa Liebaard, Desselgem, 2.1 km) is the only true walk back from Castor; everything else is a long stroll or a 5-minute cab.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Castor
siblings.summary: Kortrijk's UNESCO core, Oudenaarde's Tour of Flanders cobbles, Leiestreek breweries, the Leie towpath, and family/active picks — all within 30 km.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Castor
siblings.summary: 2026 calendar of IT and tech-industrial events within 30 km of Castor — Kortrijk Xpo, Howest, UNWRAP/FTI, recurring meetups.

sources.title: Castor — Stay the night
sources.claim: Castor's own page lists nearby lodging with measured road distances.

sources.title: Kasteel Ter Wallen — official site
sources.claim: Kasteel Ter Wallen sits in central Izegem on a 4-hectare wooded estate; 6 rooms, pool, jacuzzi.

sources.title: Ter Wallen — History
sources.claim: 1906 neo-Flemish Renaissance castle, designed by Walter Vercoutere for Joseph Van Naemen.

sources.title: Trip.com — B&B Ter Wallen
sources.claim: Ter Wallen rates from ~€204/night, 6 air-conditioned rooms.

sources.title: B&B Broel 4 — official site
sources.claim: Boutique stay in the listed 'Tack' city brewery on the Lys; four themed rooms.

sources.title: Hotel Messeyne — official site
sources.claim: Groeningestraat 17, five minutes from Grote Markt; four-star family hotel.

sources.title: Authentic Hotels — Messeyne
sources.claim: Classified monument; spiral stone staircase; 28 rooms with exposed beams.

sources.title: Hotel T — official site
sources.claim: Design-led boutique hotel at Stationsstraat 154, Waregem; rooms Roomy/Homey/Cozy/Cutie.

sources.title: Villami — official site
sources.claim: Renovated villa B&B in Vichte with Boho/Oriental/Vichte themed rooms.

sources.title: Booking.com — Villami
sources.claim: Seasonal outdoor pool, garden, shared lounge, terrace.

sources.title: Planet of Hotels — Hoeve La Cascina
sources.claim: Rural Zulte B&B with sauna, hot tub, hammam; 13.8 km to Waregem.

sources.title: TripAdvisor — La Maison des Papillons
sources.claim: 5/5 on TripAdvisor; spa, year-round outdoor pool, hot tub.

sources.title: De Pethaan — official site
sources.claim: Three-room converted farmhouse in Wielsbeke at Moerdijkstraat 26.

sources.title: bedandbreakfast.eu — Beveren-Leie
sources.claim: No B&Bs in Beveren-Leie itself; closest listings are in adjacent Waregem and Deerlijk.
